title: Pocket T-shirt
slide_intent: Use the physical object as part of the idea because a small character gesture can make merchandise memorable.
strategic_value: Duo peeking from a pocket can translate Duolingo’s personality into an everyday object without filling the whole garment.
demonstration: A model wears a white T-shirt with Duo’s eyes above the chest pocket and a green wordmark near the lower hem.
practical_value: Consider how a garment feature can give a mascot a natural position.

content_islands.name: Pocket character
content_islands.spec: Place Duo at the pocket opening on the upper chest.

content_islands.name: Hem signature
content_islands.spec: Place the green wordmark near the lower-left area of the shirt in the photograph.

content_islands.name: Garment context
content_islands.spec: Keep the model and plain background to show placement and scale.
